properties.description: Evolve the Create action in the Repositories pane into a general entry point for creation wizard modals, rather than an action specialized to creating a UI component. Work with the user to determine the creation choices, how the repository/folder selection supplies context, and how the appropriate wizard is chosen and opened. Reuse existing modal and field components. Preserve explicit destination ownership, validation and stale-write protection. Plan the scoped implementation and human review once the choices are agreed.
properties.title: Make Create the entry point for creation wizards
